nodes.name: Cu2O nanocubes synthesis
nodes.procedure: 0.17 g CuCl2·2H2O was added to 100 mL DI water and dissolved, heated up to 55 °C, and stirred for 30 min. After that, 10 mL of 2.0 M NaOH was slowly introduced to form a brown suspension under stirring. Then, 10 mL of 0.6 M ascorbic acid was added slowly into the system, and the mixed solution was aged for 3 h. The precipitate was obtained by centrifugation washing and dried overnight.
nodes.source_text: Cu2O nanocubes were synthesized according to the previous literature. Typically... The precipitate was obtained by centrifugation washing and dried overnight.

nodes.name: Ni(OH)2 nanocages synthesis
nodes.procedure: 10 mg of Cu2O nanocubes was dispersed in a 20 mL mixed solvent (water/ethanol = 1:1) via ultrasonication. Subsequently, 0.33 g of PVP (K30) was added into the above solution and the ultrasonic treatment was continued for 30 min and 3.4 mg of NiCl2·6H2O was introduced under stirring. After 30 min of stirring, 20 mL of 1.0 M Na2S2O3 was dropped slowly into the system, and a striking color change was observed. Finally, the Ni(OH)2 precursor was obtained by centrifugation washing and overnight drying.

nodes.name: NiFe PBAs nanocages synthesis
nodes.procedure: 20 mg of Ni(OH)2 nanocages was dissolved in 15 mL of ethanol by ultrasonic treatment. Simultaneously, 100 mg of K3[Fe(CN)6] was dispersed in 45 mL of DI water and dissolved to form a transparent yellow solution. Then, the K3[Fe(CN)6] solution was injected into the Ni(OH)2 suspension slowly under continuous stirring at room temperature for 1 h, 12 h, 24 h, and 48 h to get the final products (named as PBAs 1–4, respectively). Then, the product was collected by centrifugation, washed, and dried overnight.

nodes.name: CN-defected NiFe PBAs thermal activation
nodes.procedure: To remove some CN ligands, the obtained double-shelled NiFe PBAs nanocages were thermally treated at 200 °C in N2 atmosphere at a heating rate of 1 °C min−1 for 2 h (PBAs-NG/C-m) and 4 h (PBAs-NG/C), respectively.

nodes.name: NiFe PBAs nanocubes synthesis
nodes.procedure: 6.7 g Na3C6H5O7 and 1 g NiCl2·6H2O were dissolved in 250 mL DI water to obtain solution A. 2.119 g Na4[Fe(CN)6]·10H2O was also dissolved in 250 mL DI water to obtain solution B, which was poured into the solution A, and the mixture was aged for 48 h. After that, the precipitation was collected by centrifugation, washed, and dried overnight.
